final: SELECT store_id, AVG(total_amount), AVG(record_count) FROM (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.amount > 4.99 GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id) AS step1 GROUP BY store_id
